entries.note: The retailer booked the delivery, the return pickup or the service visit.

entries.note: The order reached RXO's local hub.

entries.note: A stop the tracker marks as not performed closes with this wording too; the adapter then reads the stop's exception in its place.

entries.wording: Driver is on the route to the facility
entries.note: A collected return on its way to the facility.

entries.wording: Driver has arrived at the facility
entries.note: A collected return at the facility.
The collected return is back at the retailer's facility.
The stop's exception when it was not performed, such as a delivery the customer or RXO rescheduled en route. The tracker shows the stop as an exception.
The items' exception when none of them could be delivered or collected; the tracking page's script shows such a stop as an exception.
The order's status code for a cancelled order, which the tracking page shows as Cancelled.
